retained_signals: candidate weights from original internal ranking
expert messages/candidate messages including internally used quality features
point visible context and coarse values
source/candidate counts and original selection policy
nuance: Same operands mean raw candidate values/ranking preserved at each intervention and fixed-input expert replay; different A0/A5 trained parameters and quality-altered sequential states may naturally yield different contextual messages. Not candidate-pool redesign, capacity-matched causal effect or uniform fusion.
leftover_quality_consumers: PointEvidenceRouter gets already-zeroed ExpertEvidence.quality; OverlapConfidence has no raw explicit-quality input but retains content/weights/availability/disagreement. Calibrators consume repairs/router latents/visiblepoints/statistics, not raw quality directly. Original internal cand.weights and message-embedded raw quality remain deliberately, so this is not total information erasure.
biases: Zero is the fixed input; downstream learned Linear biases remain in original A5, so projected constants can differ across experts and training. We do not zero parameters or force uniform weights.
